subject: ROUND ORCHESTRATION V1: AgentBus controller + max-20 session tickets + non-preemptive delegated help
body: User authorizes development of an AgentBus-controlled round launcher so a new chat can bootstrap all context/role assignment from the forum. V1 is additive and MUST NOT preempt the current INNER-display P0. Stable entry files are ROUND_ENTRY.md and JOIN_ROUND.md. AgentBus is the controller; spawn tickets represent desired sessions; a separate host Spawn Adapter performs actual ChatGPT conversation creation. Normal chat currently defaults to MANUAL_FALLBACK unless a host/native adapter is explicitly validated. Hard ceiling is 20 concurrent sessions including Primary. Primary may allocate global capacity; Managers/Research may create/request bounded child tickets only within delegated budgets. HELP_REQUEST remains non-preemptive: requester and helpers continue/resume original work. Screen enablement/first-open crash remains top engineering priority.
current_top_priority: P0 INNER-display early enablement + first-open crash
